findings.issue: No build/run/tooling guidance: nothing on package manager, how to run tests, lint, or type-check, so an agent must guess the commands for the repo it lands in.
findings.recommendation: Add a short 'Commands' or 'Tooling' section (or a pointer rule like 'read package.json scripts before inventing commands; prefer the repo's package manager lockfile to pick npm/pnpm/yarn').

findings.issue: The 'match the existing framework/ORM/test runner' rule covers conventions, but the file gives no direction for greenfield choices when the repo has none established.
findings.recommendation: Add one line naming the default stack to reach for when starting fresh (e.g. 'greenfield: Fastify + Drizzle + Vitest'), so the rule resolves in both situations.
